ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The image shows the shapes of four kinds of L-tromino. Each kind is the three unit squares left after taking away one unit square from a 2×2 square; that is, the three unit squares share the same corner, respectively corresponding to one of the cases in which the 2×2 square is missing the upper left, upper right, lower left, or lower right. Then reason: In a 4×4 grid, an L-tromino must be located inside some adjacent 2×2 square, and is equal to this 2×2 square with one of its unit cells removed. There are 3×3=9 adjacent 2×2 squares in a 4×4 grid. Each 2×2 square corresponds to the four L-tromino orientations in the image, so the contribution can be calculated one 2×2 square at a time. Fix a 2×2 square. If its four cells do not contain the three colors red, green, and blue, then any three cells taken from it also cannot happen to contain exactly one of each of the three colors, so it contributes 0 good L-trominoes. If this 2×2 square contains the three colors red, green, and blue, then among the four cells one color must appear twice, and the other two colors each appear once. The four L-trominoes are respectively the three cells left after deleting one of the cells. Only when the deleted cell is one of the repeated color cells will the remaining three cells happen to be exactly one each of red, green, and blue. The repeated color has two cells that can be deleted, so this 2×2 square contributes at most 2 good L-trominoes. Therefore the total number is at most 9×2=18. Below is a coloring that reaches 18: Row 1: R G B R Row 2: G B R G Row 3: B R G B Row 4: R G B R In this cyclic coloring, every adjacent 2×2 square contains the three colors red, green, and blue, so each 2×2 square contributes 2 good L-trominoes. There are 9 2×2 squares in total, so there are altogether 9×2=18 good L-trominoes. So the maximum possible number is 18.

method.method_draft: Use the image to interpret every L-tromino as one of the four ways to choose three cells from a 2 by 2 block around a common corner. In a 4 by 4 grid there are 3 by 3 = 9 such 2 by 2 blocks/internal corners, and each gives exactly the four L-tromino orientations shown. For any fixed 2 by 2 block, if its four cells do not contain all three colors, it contributes 0 good L-trominoes. If it does contain all three colors, then among the four cells one color is repeated and the other two occur once, so exactly the two L-trominoes that omit one of the repeated-color cells contain one red, one green, and one blue. Thus each 2 by 2 block contributes at most 2 good L-trominoes, giving an upper bound 9*2 = 18. Then exhibit a coloring attaining it, for example rows RGBR, GBRG, BRGB, RGBR. Every adjacent 2 by 2 block in this cyclic coloring contains all three colors, so each contributes 2 good L-trominoes, for a total of 18.

先描述图像：图中展示了四种 L-tromino 的形状。每一种都是在一个 2×2 方块中取走一个单位正方形后剩下的三个单位正方形；也就是说，三个单位正方形共享同一个角，分别对应 2×2 方块中缺少左上、右上、左下、右下中的一种情况。

再推理：在 4×4 方格中，一个 L-tromino 必然位于某个相邻的 2×2 方块内，并且等于这个 2×2 方块去掉其中一个单位格。4×4 方格中相邻的 2×2 方块共有 3×3=9 个。每个 2×2 方块对应图中四种 L-tromino 方向，所以可以逐个 2×2 方块计算贡献。

固定一个 2×2 方块。如果它的四个格子没有包含红、绿、蓝三种颜色，那么从中取出的任何三个格子也不可能恰好含有三种颜色各一个，因此贡献 0 个好的 L-tromino。

如果这个 2×2 方块包含红、绿、蓝三种颜色，那么四个格子中必有一种颜色出现两次，另外两种颜色各出现一次。四个 L-tromino 分别是删去其中一个格子后剩下的三个格子。只有当删去的是重复颜色中的一个格子时，剩下的三个格子才会恰好是红、绿、蓝各一个。重复颜色有两个格子可以删去，所以这个 2×2 方块最多贡献 2 个好的 L-tromino。

因此总数至多为 9×2=18。

下面给出达到 18 的染色：
第 1 行：R G B R
第 2 行：G B R G
第 3 行：B R G B
第 4 行：R G B R

在这个循环染色中，每个相邻的 2×2 方块都包含红、绿、蓝三种颜色，因此每个 2×2 方块都贡献 2 个好的 L-tromino。共有 9 个 2×2 方块，所以总共有 9×2=18 个好的 L-tromino。

所以最大可能数是 18。

method.method_draft: Set up an exact row-state optimization. Encode the three colors as 0,1,2 and represent each row of the 4 by 4 grid as a length-4 word, so there are 3^4 possible row states. From the image, an L-tromino in adjacent rows and adjacent columns is one of the four triples obtained by omitting one corner of that 2 by 2 window. For two row states u and v, define W(u,v) as the number of good L-trominoes using these two rows: for each of the three adjacent column pairs, check the four corner-omission triples and count those containing colors 0,1,2 exactly once. Then maximize W(r1,r2)+W(r2,r3)+W(r3,r4) over row states r1,r2,r3,r4 using the recurrence D1(u)=0 and D{k+1}(v)=max_u(Dk(u)+W(u,v)) for k=1,2,3. Evaluating this finite table gives maximum 18. A maximizing predecessor chain is 0120, 1201, 2012, 0120, which decodes to rows RGBR, GBRG, BRGB, RGBR; checking its three adjacent row pairs shows each of the nine 2 by 2 windows contributes 2 good L-trominoes, totaling 18.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：附图中显示了四个黑色轮廓的 L-tromino，每个都由一个 2×2 方块中的三个单位正方形组成，即每次缺少 2×2 方块的一个角；四幅图正好给出四种旋转方向。因此，在任意相邻两行、相邻两列形成的 2×2 窗口中，一个 L-tromino 就是从这四个角中删去一个角后剩下的三个格子。

按指定方法做行状态优化。把红、绿、蓝分别编码为 0,1,2。每一行是长度为 4 的状态 u∈{0,1,2}^4，共有 3^4=81 种。

对相邻两行状态 u=(u1,u2,u3,u4), v=(v1,v2,v3,v4)，定义 W(u,v) 为这两行中产生的好 L-tromino 数。对每个相邻列对 j=1,2,3，考虑 2×2 窗口的四个格子 a=uj, b=u{j+1}, c=vj, d=v{j+1}。图像表明四个 L-tromino 分别是删去 a,b,c,d 后得到的三格形状；于是检查三元组 {b,c,d}, {a,c,d}, {a,b,d}, {a,b,c} 是否恰好包含 0,1,2 各一次，并把满足的数量加到 W(u,v) 中。

对四行 r1,r2,r3,r4，总数为 W(r1,r2)+W(r2,r3)+W(r3,r4)，因为每个 L-tromino 都唯一地落在某一对相邻行和某一对相邻列的 2×2 窗口内。设 D1(u)=0，并递推 D{k+1}(v)=max_u(Dk(u)+W(u,v))，k=1,2,3。穷举 81 个行状态进行这个有限动态规划，最终 max_v D4(v)=18。

一个达到该值的前驱链是 0120, 1201, 2012, 0120，即四行分别为 RGBR, GBRG, BRGB, RGBR。检查相邻行对：0120/1201 的三个 2×2 窗口分别为 [0 1; 1 2], [1 2; 2 0], [2 0; 0 1]，每个窗口的四个 L 中恰有 2 个含有 0,1,2 各一次，所以 W(0120,1201)=6。同理 W(1201,2012)=6，W(2012,0120)=6。总数为 6+6+6=18。由于动态规划已经穷举所有可能的 4 行着色，所以最大值为 18。

solver_metadata.cot_raw:
先描述图像：附图中显示了四个黑色轮廓的 L-tromino，每个都由一个 2×2 方块中的三个单位正方形组成，即每次缺少 2×2 方块的一个角；四幅图正好给出四种旋转方向。因此，在任意相邻两行、相邻两列形成的 2×2 窗口中，一个 L-tromino 就是从这四个角中删去一个角后剩下的三个格子。

按指定方法做行状态优化。把红、绿、蓝分别编码为 0,1,2。每一行是长度为 4 的状态 u∈{0,1,2}^4，共有 3^4=81 种。

对相邻两行状态 u=(u1,u2,u3,u4), v=(v1,v2,v3,v4)，定义 W(u,v) 为这两行中产生的好 L-tromino 数。对每个相邻列对 j=1,2,3，考虑 2×2 窗口的四个格子 a=uj, b=u{j+1}, c=vj, d=v{j+1}。图像表明四个 L-tromino 分别是删去 a,b,c,d 后得到的三格形状；于是检查三元组 {b,c,d}, {a,c,d}, {a,b,d}, {a,b,c} 是否恰好包含 0,1,2 各一次，并把满足的数量加到 W(u,v) 中。

对四行 r1,r2,r3,r4，总数为 W(r1,r2)+W(r2,r3)+W(r3,r4)，因为每个 L-tromino 都唯一地落在某一对相邻行和某一对相邻列的 2×2 窗口内。设 D1(u)=0，并递推 D{k+1}(v)=max_u(Dk(u)+W(u,v))，k=1,2,3。穷举 81 个行状态进行这个有限动态规划，最终 max_v D4(v)=18。

一个达到该值的前驱链是 0120, 1201, 2012, 0120，即四行分别为 RGBR, GBRG, BRGB, RGBR。检查相邻行对：0120/1201 的三个 2×2 窗口分别为 [0 1; 1 2], [1 2; 2 0], [2 0; 0 1]，每个窗口的四个 L 中恰有 2 个含有 0,1,2 各一次，所以 W(0120,1201)=6。同理 W(1201,2012)=6，W(2012,0120)=6。总数为 6+6+6=18。由于动态规划已经穷举所有可能的 4 行着色，所以最大值为 18。

raw_record.original_question: Each unit square of a $4 \times 4$ square grid is colored either red, green, or blue. Over all possible colorings of the grid, what is the maximum possible number of L-trominos that contain exactly one square of each color? (L-trominos are made up of three unit squares sharing a corner, as shown below.)\n<image1>
raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the image: The image shows the shapes of four kinds of L-tromino. Each kind is the three unit squares left after taking away one unit square from a 2×2 square; that is, the three unit squares share the same corner, respectively corresponding to one of the cases in which the 2×2 square is missing the upper left, upper right, lower left, or lower right.

Then reason: In a 4×4 grid, an L-tromino must be located inside some adjacent 2×2 square, and is equal to this 2×2 square with one of its unit cells removed. There are 3×3=9 adjacent 2×2 squares in a 4×4 grid. Each 2×2 square corresponds to the four L-tromino orientations in the image, so the contribution can be calculated one 2×2 square at a time.

Fix a 2×2 square. If its four cells do not contain the three colors red, green, and blue, then any three cells taken from it also cannot happen to contain exactly one of each of the three colors, so it contributes 0 good L-trominoes.

If this 2×2 square contains the three colors red, green, and blue, then among the four cells one color must appear twice, and the other two colors each appear once. The four L-trominoes are respectively the three cells left after deleting one of the cells. Only when the deleted cell is one of the repeated color cells will the remaining three cells happen to be exactly one each of red, green, and blue. The repeated color has two cells that can be deleted, so this 2×2 square contributes at most 2 good L-trominoes.

Therefore the total number is at most 9×2=18.

Below is a coloring that reaches 18:
Row 1: R G B R
Row 2: G B R G
Row 3: B R G B
Row 4: R G B R

In this cyclic coloring, every adjacent 2×2 square contains the three colors red, green, and blue, so each 2×2 square contributes 2 good L-trominoes. There are 9 2×2 squares in total, so there are altogether 9×2=18 good L-trominoes.

So the maximum possible number is 18.
